title: Irascible
summary: IRAS'CIBLE, a. [L. irascor, from ira. See Ire.] Very susceptible of anger; easily provoked or inflamed with resentment; irritable; as an irascible man; an irascible temper.

inlines.v: IRAS'CIBLE, a. [L. irascor, from ira. See Ire.] Very susceptible of anger; easily provoked or inflamed with resentment; irritable; as an irascible man; an irascible temper.
